# Style 08 · Clinical Clarity

> Calm, clear and easy to trust.

**Keywords:** Trustworthy · Clean · Caring · Accessible · Reassuring  
**Sample brand in examples:** Clearpoint Clinics, multi-specialty clinic group (invented)

## Concept

Clinical Clarity combines clean white space with calm teal, friendly rounded geometry and highly legible type. It reassures people when they may be anxious, and it is built for accessibility first: strong contrast, clear actions and plain language.

## Target industries

- Hospitals and clinics
- Pharma and medical devices
- Health insurance
- Dental and aesthetics clinics
- Education and e-learning
- Government and public services

## Color palette

| Name | Hex | Role | Share |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| White | `#FFFFFF` | Primary background | 55% |
| Mist | `#EEF5F6` | Section tints, cards | 18% |
| Deep Ink | `#13293D` | Text, headers | 14% |
| Care Teal | `#0F7C80` | Brand colour, primary actions | 9% |
| Sunrise | `#F4A259` | Warm accent, highlights | 3% |
| Leaf | `#2E8B57` | Success, availability | 1% |

**Rule:** Care Teal carries actions and must pass AA contrast (4.5:1) on white. Sunrise adds warmth and is never used for text.

## Typography

| Role | Family | Weights | Use |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | **Plus Jakarta Sans** | 600, 700 | Headlines, numbers |
| Body | **Plus Jakarta Sans** | 400, 500 | Body, forms, UI |
| Arabic | **IBM Plex Sans Arabic · Tajawal** | | Use clear, open Arabic sans faces. Set Arabic body text one size larger than Latin for readability. |

**Type scale** (desktop, px size / line height)

| Level | Size | Weight | Detail |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Display | 56 / 64 | 700 | -2% tracking |
| H1 | 40 / 48 | 700 | Sentence case |
| H2 | 24 / 32 | 600 | Sentence case |
| Body | 18 / 28 | 400 | Minimum 16px anywhere |
| Label | 14 / 20 | 500 | Sentence case |

- Write in plain language at about a 12-year-old reading level.
- Never set body text below 16px.
- Lead with what the patient can do: book, call, find.

## Layout rules

- **Grid:** 12 columns · 24px gutter · 1200px max container
- **Spacing:** 8px base. Comfortable 24px card padding, 96px section spacing.
- **Corners:** 12px cards · 10px buttons · 50% icon containers

- Put a primary action (Book, Call) on every screen.
- Use Mist-tinted sections to group related information.
- Show icons in soft teal circles with a short label.
- Make touch targets at least 44px.
- Use a soft, low shadow on interactive cards only.

## Photography direction

Real staff and patients in bright, clean spaces with warm human moments.

- Real doctors and nurses, smiling and attentive.
- Patient interactions show care: eye contact, listening.
- Bright, airy interiors with natural light.
- Diverse ages and backgrounds, shown with dignity.
- Avoid needles, blood and anything distressing.

**Sample shot list**

1. Doctor listening to elderly patient, daylight (grade: `#E3F0F1` → `#9CCBCD` → `#0F7C80`)
2. Bright reception with plants (grade: `#F4F8F8` → `#C9DEDF` → `#5C8F92`)
3. Child laughing with nurse (grade: `#FCE6D2` → `#F4A259` → `#0F7C80`)

**Avoid**

- Clinical close-ups of procedures
- Cold blue hospital lighting
- Obviously staged stock models

## Graphic elements

- Line icons in soft teal circles
- Rounded info cards with icon headers
- Gentle wave or arc dividers
- Step indicators for patient journeys
- Availability dots in Leaf green

## UI examples

- Primary buttons: solid Care Teal, white text, 10px radius.
- Large form fields with clear labels and helper text.
- Doctor cards with photo, specialty and next availability.
- Visible focus rings for keyboard users.

- Primary button: `Book an appointment` · Secondary button: `Find a doctor`
- Input: Preferred date: `Tue, 14 October`
- Tags: `Cardiology` `Available today` `Arabic · English`
- Card: **Dr. Sara Al-Amin**, Cardiologist · 12 yrs, Next: 10:30

## Social media examples

- Health tips in simple carousels: one tip per slide.
- Meet-the-doctor posts with a portrait and a quote.
- Awareness days use the same template with a Sunrise highlight.

| Format | Eyebrow | Headline | CTA |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Feed post 1080 × 1080 | Heart health | 3 signs it's time for a check-up. |  |
| Story 1080 × 1920 | Now open | Same-day appointments | Book |
| Feed ad 1080 × 1350 | Family care | Specialists for every age. | Book online |

## Website example

- Hero with a clear headline, search for doctors and booking.
- Specialties as an icon grid.
- Trust signals: accreditations, years of service, reviews.

- **Navigation:** Specialties · Doctors · Locations · Contact
- **Hero eyebrow:** Clearpoint Clinics
- **Hero headline:** Care that listens.
- **Hero copy:** Book with over 80 specialists across six clinics, with same-day appointments available.
- **Actions:** Book an appointment / Find a doctor
- **Proof row:** 80+ (Specialists across 22 fields) · Same day (Appointments at every clinic) · JCI (Internationally accredited)

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Design for accessibility first | Medical jargon in headlines |
| Use plain language | Low-contrast pastel text |
| Show real people | Fear-based messaging |
